purpose: Migration manifest + anti-regression contract for the pyprefix typed-identifier convention (owner-directed 2026-06-27). Encode each definition's kind in its name so deterministic code graphs need no LLM. A path listed in `migrated` MUST stay 100% conformant (pyprefix check == 0 violations); the gate scripts/check_pyprefix_conformance.py enforces it so renamed code can never silently diverge.
policy: Add a path to `migrated` ONLY after (1) `pyprefix apply <path>` renames it, (2) `pyprefix check <path>` reports 0 violations, and (3) the FULL proof gate (scripts/run_proofs.py) is green. Migrate package by package; the gate is the oracle for cross-file safety, not compile() alone.
deferred_reason: methods + instances are referenced as attributes (obj.method) which static analysis cannot resolve across duck-typed receivers; args require signature/keyword-call rewrites; class/body vars include dataclass fields and protocol attributes that must be coordinated with constructors, attribute access, serialization, and tests. Locals are supported by the scoped renamer and included in the operation graph.
